claims.statement: When an agent forms a consequential new product possibility, it can preserve the intended beneficiary effect and its evaluation frame as a linked, source-attributed prospective hypothesis in the same unreviewed synthesis proposal. A later agent can use the original criterion, comparison and reversal conditions when assessing outcomes and reconsidering value.

value_frame.beneficiary: An authorized coding agent responsible for a consequential multi-session product-development choice.
value_frame.criterion: Decision-useful prospective accountability: preserve the original anticipated beneficiary effect and the conditions that would justify revising it, not the number of prediction records or more context by itself.
value_frame.comparison_baseline: Existing synthesis producer plus manual authored consequence record and ordinary Git review. The November 27 value-feedback construction retrospectively normalized the detached-stewardship hypothesis; manual original-source recovery remains available and may be cheaper for an isolated case.
value_frame.expected_observation: A real new synthesis yields a hypothetical opportunity and one explicitly linked hypothesis containing the verbatim value statement, beneficiary, criterion, comparison and reversal condition; detached preflight and an ordinary reviewed exact-source query recover them as NO_ASSESSMENT before any later outcome claim. Later consequential use would need to compare the original criterion with actual observations, not merely find the record.
value_frame.would_change_decision_if: The producer or consumer loses the original frame, suggests evidence or authority from a prediction alone, or actual later reviewers find the explicit frame redundant with ordinary source recovery or too burdensome. Retain manual writing as a viable fallback.
value_frame.cost_and_downside: One optional authoring object and one additional hypothesis/relation per opted-in synthesis, with review and retention cost. Do not populate every possibility or infer chronology from the producer output; no comparative time saving is yet measured.
